title: 6.17.4 Lab: Launch!
description: The catapult fires: aim with the arm, release to launch, and watch the arc.

steps.title: Run it
steps.instructions: The arm aims and nothing fires.

steps.title: Fire
steps.instructions: Add the release launch from the sub-build: a stone at the arm, direction from the arm, a speed, pushed into `shots`.

steps.title: Watch the arc
steps.instructions: Aim high and fire: the stone should climb, slow, and come down further away than a flat shot.
hints: Gravity bends the path; the speed sets how far.
A stone that goes straight is in zero gravity.

requirements.title: Fired on release
requirements.description: A new sprite is made inside mouse.released() and pushed into the array. Help: 6.17.1 (Reading: Launching on release)

requirements.title: Along the arm
requirements.description: Direction comes from the arm rotation, with a speed. Help: 6.17.1 (Reading: Launching on release)

aiCheck.rubricTitle: What the AI read in your code
aiCheck.prompt: The student wrote a moSHion sketch for "Lab: Launch!". The task: fire a stone on release along the arm with a speed, and keep every stone in an array. Accept any names, helpers, ternaries and semicolons; a line only in a comment or string does not count. Short, plain notes for a 14-year-old; never write corrected code.
